articles.title: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
articles.essence: Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes. articles.title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
articles.essence: New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago schools are considering Google alternatives after the company said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, according to The New York Times. Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powered features without also disabling Search.

articles.title: Democrats skip a vote on adding Brendan Carr’s adviser to the FCC
articles.essence: Senate commerce committee Chair Ted Cruz (R-TX) began a meeting Wednesday meant to confirm President Donald Trump's nominee to the Federal Communications Commission with a lopsided dais. To his right sat all 14 Republican members of the panel, including Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD).

articles.title: Absolute Batman can save DC Studios
articles.essence: With James Gunn and Peter Safran out as the co-heads of DC Studios following Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, it's unclear what will become of the cinematic universe that was building around movies like last year's Superman.
